in_sanskrit.name: Vish-nu
in_sanskrit.meaning: all pervading, all knowing, all powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The preserver and protector of the universe, the supreme deity in Hinduism, and one of the primary gods in the Hindu pantheon, representing love, preservation, and protection.

in_marathi.name: Visu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Visu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The preserver and protector in the Hindu Trimurti, Lord Vishnu is the god of preservation, protection and sustenance. He is also known as the god of the universe, pervading all things and maintaining the balance of nature.

in_bengali.name: Visu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord Vishnu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Visu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The preserver and protector in the Hindu Trimurti, Lord Vishnu is the god of preservation, protection and sustenance. He is also known as the god of the universe, pervading all things and maintaining the balance of nature.
